comments.text: The historical research in this video is brilliant! I always wondered why Spain's schedule was so late, and learning that it's a lingering effect of General Franco aligning the clocks with Central Europe in 1940 [09:02] is a mind-blowing geopolitical hangover! Also, seeing the Sagrada Familia finally reach its peak in 2026 [16:06] after 144 years is surreal. For the pinned question: The culture and history are definitely what would draw me there! 🍷⛪
